test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.**

Lethargy
solution: The correct answer is: **Attention**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Lethargy **means a lack of energy or enthusiasm. (ऊर्जा या उत्साह की कमी) • **For example**: *After the meal, I could feel the lethargy in my body.* • An antonym is a word that has an opposite meaning to another word. • Marked option **Attention **means the act of focusing on something or someone. (किसी चीज़ या व्यक्ति पर ध्यान केंद्रित करने की क्रिया) • **For example**: *Now turn your attention to the next task.* • Therefore, Attention is the most appropriate antonym for Lethargy. Hence, **option 2** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Refusal **means the act of declining or rejecting something. (किसी चीज़ को अस्वीकार या अस्वीकार करने की क्रिया या भाव) • **Shield **means a protective barrier or cover. (एक सुरक्षात्मक बाधा या आवरण) • **Existence **means the fact or state of being alive or present. (जीवित या वर्तमान होने का तथ्य या अवस्था) 1dd:Ta26, The correct answer is: **Sustained**.
